import pandas as pd

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

water_temp = pd.read_csv('/root/data/water_temperature.csv')
climate = pd.read_csv('/root/data/climate.csv')
land_cover = pd.read_csv('/root/data/land_cover.csv')
hydrology = pd.read_csv('/root/data/hydrology.csv')

# Merge all data on Year

# 1. Trend Analysis - Linear regression of WaterTemperature vs Year
X_trend = data[['Year']].values
y_trend = data['WaterTemperature'].values

# Perform linear regression

            corr, _ = stats.pearsonr(data[var], data['WaterTemperature'])
            # Use absolute correlation as contribution measure
            contributions[var] = {'category': category, 'correlation': abs(corr), 'raw_corr': corr}

# Alternative approach: Use regression coefficients
# Standardize all predictor variables
predictor_vars = []
for vars_list in categories.values():
    predictor_vars.extend(vars_list)

X_factors = data[predictor_vars].values
y_temp = data['WaterTemperature'].values

# Standardize to compare coefficients fairly
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_factors_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_factors)

# Fit regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X_factors_scaled, y_temp)

# Get coefficients
coefficients = {}
for i, var in enumerate(predictor_vars):
    coefficients[var] = abs(model.coef_[i])

# Calculate category contributions by summing absolute coefficients
category_contributions = {}
for category, variables in categories.items():
    total_contrib = sum(coefficients.get(var, 0) for var in variables)
    category_contributions[category] = total_contrib

# Find dominant category
total_contribution = sum(category_contributions.values())
dominant_category = max(category_contributions, key=category_contributions.get)
dominant_contribution_pct = (category_contributions[dominant_category] / total_contribution) * 100

# Find the most important variable in the dominant category
dominant_var = None
max_coef = 0
for var in categories[dominant_category]:
    if coefficients[var] > max_coef:
        max_coef = coefficients[var]
        dominant_var = var

print(f"\nDominant Category: {dominant_category}")
print(f"Contribution: {dominant_contribution_pct:.2f}%")
print(f"Most important variable: {dominant_var}")

# Save dominant factor results
dominant_result = pd.DataFrame({
    'variable': [dominant_category],
    'contribution': [dominant_contribution_pct]
})
dominant_result.to_csv('/root/output/dominant_factor.csv', index=False)

print("\nAnalysis complete. Results saved to /root/output/")
EOF
